rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an amount charged or a fee, when no more specific type is intended.

example.english: How much is the entrance fee?
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 sau1 fai3 gei2 do1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for the amount payable for professional work, especially when describing it as a cost or expense.

example.english: The fee for hiring a lawyer isn't cheap.
example.jyutping: wan2 leot6 si1 ge3 fai3 jung6 m4 peng4

rows.note: Use this when the fee is specifically for providing a service, including a professional or customer-facing service.

example.english: Does this bill include the service fee?
example.jyutping: zoeng1 daan1 baau1 m4 baau1 fuk6 mou6 fai3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the fee is an extra surcharge added because of a privilege, special condition, or service.

example.english: There is an additional fee for nighttime delivery.
example.traditional: 夜間送貨要收附加費㗎。
example.jyutping: je6 gaan1 sung3 fo3 jiu3 sau1 fu6 gaa1 fai3 gaa3
